project.name: @kehto/firewall
project.summary: Pure approval policy for napplets (sandboxed iframe apps): it records what a person approved for each verified napplet (which NAP interfaces, resources and network addresses), decides whether a new request is covered, and stores allow/ask/deny rules. It counts nothing over time; rate limits live in a separate package.

steps.note: The runtime passes the napplet's verified identity and what it is asking for.
Each requested interface, resource or network address is normalised and matched against stored approvals; an explicit denial wins, and anything uncovered is reported back as missing.
For requests no approval covers, the host can look up the standing allow, ask or deny rule for that napplet or operation.

tour.title: What this package is
tour.note: A pure library that decides whether a person's approvals cover what a napplet asks to do. No timers, no saving to disk by itself.

tour.title: Approvals
tour.note: The heart of it: approvals are tied to a verified napplet identity (signed listing plus content hash) or to a development target, and each request must be covered piece by piece.

tour.title: Standing rules
tour.note: Allow, ask or deny settings for a whole interface or a single operation, so the host knows whether to prompt.
